## Change and reason

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or research claim.

## Evidence

List the exact commands, source/data versions, and completed outcomes.
State whether this is a bounded check or a full reproduction.

## Research impact

Identify any changes to rules, indexing, P/N results, artifact provenance,
or formal verification status. Describe remaining limitations.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] Every commit is cryptographically signed and Verified on GitHub.
- [ ] Repository content and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; UNKNOWN and partial runs are identified accurately.
- [ ] New artifacts have provenance and checksums, with no secrets or private paths.
- [ ] External sources, license obligations, and material AI assistance are disclosed.
